import importlib.util
root=Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('search', root/'search.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
cases={
 '  hello   world  ':'hello world',
 '\t hello\nworld \r':'hello world',
 '  微信   语音  ':'微信 语音',
 '':'',
 '   ':'',
}
for raw,want in cases.items():
    got=m.normalize_query(raw)
    assert got==want,(raw,got,want)

tasks.description: Configuration precedence bug requiring exact fallback semantics.
tasks.prompt: Fix config.resolve_endpoint. Explicit argument must win when non-empty; otherwise use SERVICE_ENDPOINT from the supplied env mapping when non-empty; otherwise return DEFAULT_ENDPOINT. Treat whitespace-only values as empty. Do not read os.environ implicitly and keep the existing public signature.

files.config.py:
DEFAULT_ENDPOINT = 'https://api.example.test'

def resolve_endpoint(explicit, env):
    # BUG: env always wins and whitespace values leak through.
    return env.get('SERVICE_ENDPOINT') or explicit or DEFAULT_ENDPOINT

tasks.description: Retry semantics with precise attempt accounting and selective exception handling.
tasks.prompt: Fix retry.call_with_retry. It must attempt at most max_attempts times, retry only RetryableError, return immediately on success, propagate non-retryable exceptions unchanged, and raise the final RetryableError after the budget is exhausted. max_attempts < 1 must raise ValueError before calling the function. Keep the API synchronous and do not add sleeps.

import importlib.util,tempfile,os,json,unittest.mock as mock
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('state',Path.cwd()/'state.py')
